rows.reasoning: H.J.Res. 126 disapproves an FDIC climate-related financial risk rule for banks and H.R. 1435 limits state vehicle-emission waivers; neither speaks to whether government should require, fund, speed up, stay neutral on, or end support for clean energy. Her press-release words ("The FDIC is not a climate regulator", praise for a nuclear microreactor) name no clean-energy mechanism, so no passage reaches any rung.
